name: Why shouldn't I try to repair storm damage myself?

mainEntity.name: Why shouldn't I try to repair storm damage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attempting DIY repairs after significant storm damage can be risky and may lead to further problems. Without proper training and equipment, you might overlook hidden damage, compromise structural integrity, or expose yourself to hazards like mold or electrical issues. Additionally, improper repairs might not meet building codes or insurance requirements, potentially complicating future claims or property sales. Professional restorers ensure thorough, safe, and code-compliant work.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY storm damage repairs can be risky, lead to overlooked issues, or fail to meet codes, potentially complicating insurance and future property concerns.
